title: subject + details + style

body.text: A good prompt is ordered as
subject (what) + details (color, pose, scene) + style/mood + quality words
, e.g. 'a woman, red dress, walking in rain, cinematic, moody, highly detailed.' Order and commas help the AI tell things apart.

example: a samurai standing in bamboo forest, morning mist, dramatic lighting, cinematic, ultra detailed

title: Medium and style words

body.text: like 'oil painting', 'watercolor', '3D render', 'photograph, 35mm', plus lighting like 'golden hour' or 'studio lighting'. These words shape the look of the image strongly.

example: a mountain landscape, watercolor painting, soft pastel colors, dreamy, loose brush strokes
